relations.description: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure starts timer T3591.
Procedure includes sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.
On T3591 expiry, SMF resends PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND and resets timer.
On fifth T3591 expiry, SMF aborts procedure and enters PDU SESSION ACTIVE state.
Receipt of PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST triggers UE-requested PDU session release procedure.
Receipt of PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST during network-requested modification procedure causes abortion of modification procedure.
In PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING state, network ignores received PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST messages.
Receipt of PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST during network-requested modification procedure causes abortion of modification procedure.
Indication to re-establish user-plane resources causes abortion of network-requested PDU session modification procedure.
When handover is completed successfully, SMF may re-initiate network-requested PDU session modification procedure.
